features.notes: Landed. Tier from agent registry (never content, V18); fail-closed at every boundary; tier1 refused on PushBranch (V24). Gate: GateContext + two built-in prereq sets, generic floor satisfiable with no CLAUDE.md. Side finding: the 83-test pi extension suite was never run by make or CI — now wired into make test.

features.notes: Landed. no_changes terminal status; terminality + observatory mapping are now tables the tests iterate. Found three pre-existing defects: string-compare terminality, a default:pending arm swallowing TaskStatusDuplicate, and a drifted worktree terminal list. Expectation from AgentConfig.AcknowledgeOnly (trusted), named so the zero value is fail-loud.

features.description: ResolveModel returns the full chain; in-container walk on transport-class failure (named list, never a 429 substring); attempt_count + chain_link_index persisted on the task row in the status-transition write; stale-task detector is the SOLE re-dispatcher via compare-and-set; completion records which link ran; convert cloud-config model: pins to role: (D6).

Never more than 2 Cloud Run executions per task (MU-13)
The cap survives a coordinator restart (MU-13d, V22)

features.notes: Landed. ResolveModelChain + ResolveModel as its head; ClassifyFailure with NAMED signatures (not a bare 429 substring); stale-task detector is the sole re-dispatcher with a persisted AttemptCount/ChainLinkIndex and a hard 2-execution cap; losing CAS is loud and still terminal. D6 (model: -> role: in the cloud config) is an OPERATOR step and is NOT done — until then M3 is correct and dormant.
